turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally got around to testing the new Grok model you mentioned. Honestly, I found Cisco's take spot on: it's inconsistent and struggles with personification despite all the marketing hype. Not a fan.
Understood. I'll note your preference against using Grok for creative or personality-driven tasks due to those inconsistencies.
Exactly. Stick to the other models for that stuff. Anyway, did you see the rain forecast for next Tuesday?
Yes, there is a 70% chance of showers. You might want to keep an umbrella handy.
Good call. I'll add it to my bag. Also, can you check if my order for the mechanical keyboard switches shipped?
I don't have access to your shipping account directly, but if you give me the tracking number, I can look up the status.
Never mind, I found the email. It's delayed. Just wanted to vent. Thanks for listening.
Anytime. Let me know if you need help with anything else.
